title: Carrie
description: A bullied, telekinetic teenager's high school torment ignites into a night of catastrophic revenge.

title: 'Salem's Lot
description: A writer returns to his Maine hometown to find its residents falling prey, one by one, to a vampire who has settled into an old house on the hill.

title: The Shining
description: A recovering alcoholic takes a winter caretaker job at an isolated mountain hotel, where its malevolent history begins to prey on his mind and endanger his psychic young son.

title: Rage
description: A troubled high schooler takes his algebra class hostage at gunpoint, and what begins as a standoff turns into a strange, tense group confession.

title: Night Shift
description: King's first collection of short fiction, gathering early stories of everyday people confronted by the uncanny and the monstrous.

title: The Stand
description: A weaponized strain of super-flu wipes out most of humanity, and the survivors are drawn into an epic, continent-spanning struggle between good and evil.

title: The Long Walk
description: In a grim alternate America, one hundred teenage boys must keep walking without stopping, on pain of death, until only one remains.

title: The Dead Zone
description: After waking from a five-year coma with the power to see a person's future by touch, a man is confronted with a vision of catastrophe tied to an ambitious politician.

title: Firestarter
description: A little girl born with the power to start fires with her mind goes on the run with her father from a secret government agency that wants to weaponize her.

title: Roadwork
description: A man's quiet grief over his son's death curdles into obsession and violence when a highway project forces him from the only home he has left.

title: Danse Macabre
description: King's own tour through the horror genre's history and inner workings, tracing its influence across fiction, film, radio, and television.

title: Cujo
description: A gentle family dog turns rabid, trapping a mother and her young son in a broken-down car under the summer sun.

title: The Running Man
description: In a bleak future America, a desperate man agrees to star on a deadly game show where he must survive as a hunted target for thirty days.

title: The Gunslinger
description: Gunslinger Roland Deschain begins his long pursuit of the man in black across a desert wasteland, the first step of his quest toward the Dark Tower.

title: Different Seasons
description: Four novellas exploring hope, revenge, memory, and the end of childhood, set largely outside King's usual horror territory.

title: Christine
description: A shy teenager's obsession with a beautifully restored, murderous vintage Plymouth Fury begins to consume, and endanger, everyone around him.

title: Cycle of the Werewolf
description: Over the course of a year, a small Maine town is stalked, one full moon at a time, by a werewolf hiding in plain sight among its neighbors.

title: Pet Sematary
description: After discovering a burial ground behind his new home that can bring the dead back wrong, a grieving father makes an unthinkable choice.

title: The Eyes of the Dragon
description: A falsely accused prince must escape imprisonment and reclaim his kingdom from the treacherous magician who framed him, in this fantasy fable for readers young and old.

title: The Talisman
description: A boy crosses between our world and a parallel realm called the Territories on a quest to find a magical talisman that can save his dying mother.

title: Thinner
description: A curse from a wronged old man leaves an overweight lawyer losing weight without end, and no explanation will make it stop.

title: Skeleton Crew
description: A wide-ranging collection of stories and novellas, from a fog that hides ravenous creatures to a raft besieged in a lake, showcasing King's range beyond the novel.

title: IT
description: Seven childhood friends who once defeated a shape-shifting evil haunting their town must reunite as adults when it returns, twenty-seven years later.

title: The Drawing of the Three
description: Roland draws three companions from other worlds and other times through mysterious doors on a beach, forging the allies he'll need for his quest.

title: Misery
description: A novelist is rescued from a car crash by his self-proclaimed 'number one fan', and then held captive by her when she discovers he has killed off her favorite character.

title: The Tommyknockers
description: A writer unearths a buried alien spacecraft in the woods behind her home, and its strange influence begins transforming her entire town.

title: The Dark Half
description: A novelist's violent pseudonym, publicly killed off, comes to murderous life of its own and begins hunting down everyone who helped end it.

title: The Stand: The Complete & Uncut Edition
description: The expanded, restored edition of The Stand, returning scenes trimmed from the original publication to King's sweeping post-apocalyptic epic.

title: Four Past Midnight
description: Four novellas: a plane's passengers land in a world gone wrong, a writer is stalked by an accuser claiming plagiarism, a childhood library fine reveals something monstrous, and a cursed Polaroid camera captures a beast slowly breaking free.

title: The Waste Lands
description: Roland's growing band presses on toward the Tower through a poisoned, dying land and the ruined city of Lud, pursued by an increasingly unstable guide.

title: Needful Things
description: A new shop selling exactly what each customer secretly desires opens in a quiet Maine town, and its charming owner's price sets neighbor against neighbor.

title: Gerald's Game
description: Handcuffed to a bed after a sex game goes wrong and her husband dies, a woman is left alone to confront both her isolation and long-buried memories.

title: Dolores Claiborne
description: During a solar eclipse, a housekeeper is suspected of murdering her wealthy employer, forcing her to finally reveal a dark secret from her own past.

title: Nightmares & Dreamscapes
description: A sprawling collection of short stories and novellas spanning horror, suspense, and the strange, including collaborations and non-horror detours.

title: Insomnia
description: An elderly widower's crippling insomnia opens his eyes to invisible forces at war over the fate of a young boy, and perhaps the whole world.

title: Rose Madder
description: Fleeing her abusive husband, a woman finds herself drawn into a mysterious painting that offers her both refuge and a path to confront him.

title: The Green Mile
description: A death row guard in 1930s Louisiana comes to believe that one of the inmates awaiting execution possesses a miraculous, healing gift.

title: Desperation
description: Travelers passing through a nearly abandoned Nevada mining town are rounded up by a corrupt sheriff possessed by an ancient evil unearthed from the mines.

title: The Regulators
description: A quiet suburban street is besieged by impossible violence after a boy's dark imagination and a malevolent force merge into deadly reality.

title: Wizard and Glass
description: Roland recounts the tragic story of his youth and first love, a tale of betrayal that shaped the gunslinger he would become.

title: Bag of Bones
description: A grieving widower retreats to his late wife's lake house, where he's drawn into a decades-old town secret and haunted by increasingly insistent ghosts.

title: The Girl Who Loved Tom Gordon
description: A nine-year-old girl lost alone in the Maine woods clings to her love of baseball to survive, as something unseen seems to stalk her through the trees.

title: Hearts in Atlantis
description: Interconnected stories tracing a group of characters from a haunting 1960s childhood summer through the shadow the era casts over their later lives.

title: Storm of the Century
description: A supernatural stranger arrives in a storm-cut-off Maine island town and offers its people an impossible bargain to spare their lives.

title: On Writing: A Memoir of the Craft
description: Part memoir, part practical guide, King recounts his path to becoming a writer alongside his hard-won thoughts on the craft itself.

title: Dreamcatcher
description: Four childhood friends on a hunting trip find their reunion upended by a horrifying alien threat and the strange bond that has connected them since childhood.

title: Black House
description: Years after his journey through the Territories, a retired detective is pulled back into that other world to save a kidnapped child from a serial killer.

title: Everything's Eventual
description: A wide-ranging collection of stories blending horror, dark fantasy, and King's ongoing Dark Tower mythology.

title: From a Buick 8
description: A Pennsylvania state police troop has spent decades quietly guarding a mysterious car in their garage that seems to be a door to somewhere else entirely.

title: Wolves of the Calla
description: Roland's ka-tet agrees to defend a farming village from child-stealing raiders, while a dangerous rift over an object from another story threatens to divide them.

title: Song of Susannah
description: As Susannah is drawn away pregnant with a monstrous child, the ka-tet splits apart to save her and to protect their author from beyond the story's edges.

title: The Dark Tower
description: Roland's quest reaches its long-awaited climax as the surviving ka-tet make their final approach to the Tower at the heart of all worlds.

title: Faithful
description: A season-long diary of the Boston Red Sox's historic 2004 championship run, co-written by two die-hard fans.

title: The Colorado Kid
description: Two veteran newspapermen tell a young intern about the strangest unsolved case of their careers: a body on a beach with no explanation.

title: Cell
description: A signal broadcast to cell phones instantly turns everyone who hears it into a mindless, violent killer, and the few who missed the call must survive the aftermath.

title: Lisey's Story
description: Two years after her novelist husband's death, a widow is forced to confront both a dangerous stalker and the strange, private world her husband kept hidden from her.

title: Blaze
description: Guided by the voice of his dead partner in crime, a none-too-bright ex-con attempts one last desperate kidnapping scheme.

title: Duma Key
description: Recovering from a devastating accident, a man retreats to a Florida island where his newfound talent for painting begins to reveal, and unleash, something dangerous.

title: Just After Sunset
description: A collection of short stories exploring ordinary lives interrupted by the uncanny, the desperate, and the inexplicable.

title: Under the Dome
description: A small Maine town is suddenly sealed off from the outside world by an invisible, impenetrable dome, and the power struggle within turns deadly.

title: Blockade Billy
description: An old-timer recalls the brief, forgotten career of the best catcher he ever saw, and the dark secret that ended it.

title: Full Dark, No Stars
description: Four novellas of ordinary people driven to retribution and violence by betrayal, desperation, and quiet rage.
A high school teacher discovers a portal to 1958 and sets out on an obsessive mission to stop the assassination of John F. Kennedy.

title: The Wind Through the Keyhole
description: A story set between Wizard and Glass and Wolves of the Calla, as Roland recounts a formative early adventure and the fairy tale told to him as a boy.

title: Joyland
description: A college student takes a summer job at a fading amusement park and becomes drawn into the decades-old unsolved murder of a young woman on one of its rides.

title: Doctor Sleep
description: Decades after surviving the Overlook Hotel, an adult Danny Torrance uses his psychic gift to protect a girl with similar powers from a cult that feeds on children like her.

title: Mr. Mercedes
description: A retired detective is taunted by the still-at-large killer behind an unsolved mass-casualty attack, and sets out to catch him before he strikes again.

title: Revival
description: A small-town minister's fall from faith leads him down a lifelong, increasingly dangerous obsession with a forbidden kind of electricity.

title: Finders Keepers
description: A stolen cache of notebooks containing a reclusive author's final work draws a young fan and a desperate ex-con into violent collision.

title: The Bazaar of Bad Dreams
description: A collection of short stories, several written specifically for this volume, ranging across horror, suspense, and quiet tragedy.

title: End of Watch
description: Retired detective Bill Hodges faces one final case against his old nemesis, whose new scheme uses a sinister device to drive victims to suicide.

title: Charlie the Choo-Choo
description: A picture book about a friendly train named Charlie and his engineer, presented as the storybook referenced within King's own Dark Tower series.

title: Gwendy's Button Box
description: A young girl is given a mysterious box whose buttons can bring good fortune or terrible destruction, and must decide whether she can be trusted with it.

title: Sleeping Beauties
description: Women around the world begin falling into a mysterious sleep from which they cannot be woken, cocooned and left unrecognizable if disturbed, as the men left behind spiral toward violence.

title: The Outsider
description: A beloved coach is accused of a brutal murder with airtight evidence placing him at the scene, and equally airtight evidence placing him somewhere else entirely.

title: Elevation
description: A man in a small Colorado town notices he's steadily losing weight with no visible change to his body, even as he works to befriend two neighbors the town has frozen out.

title: The Institute
description: Children with budding psychic abilities are abducted and held in a secretive facility that tests the limits of their powers, and their will to escape.

title: If It Bleeds
description: Four novellas including a further outing for the psychic investigator Holly Gibney, who tracks a shape-shifting entity that feeds on tragedy.

title: Later
description: A boy who can see and speak with the dead is pulled into a police investigation when his ability makes him useful to the wrong people.

title: Billy Summers
description: A retiring hitman who only kills bad people takes one final job, only to find himself betrayed and on the run alongside a woman he rescues along the way.

title: Gwendy's Final Task
description: Now a US senator, Gwendy Peterson is reunited with her old button box for one last, world-spanning mission tied to the Dark Tower's fate.

title: Fairy Tale
description: A teenager inherits a portal to a decaying fantasy kingdom from a dying neighbor's backyard shed, and must journey there to save it from ancient tyranny.

title: Holly
description: Series detective Holly Gibney investigates the disappearance of a college student and uncovers a monstrous elderly couple with a horrifying secret.

title: You Like It Darker
description: A collection of stories examining fate, mortality, and the unseen forces tugging at ordinary lives.

title: Never Flinch
description: Holly Gibney takes on a killer vowing to murder innocents in atonement for one wrongful execution, while also guarding a controversial speaker facing death threats.
